title: On the Complementarity of Quantum and Classical Features: Adaptive Hybrid Quantum-Classical Feature Fusion for Breast Cancer Classification
abstract: arXiv:2604.22903v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The integration of quantum machine learning with classical deep learning offers promising avenues for medical image analysis by mapping data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces. However, unifying these paradigms remains challenging due to optimization asymmetries. We propose a hybrid quantum-classical architecture for breast cancer diagnosis based on a dual-branch feature-extraction pipeline. Our framework unifies complementary representations from classical models and trainable or deterministic (non-trainable) quantum circuits. Three fusion strategies are introduced: Static Hybrid Fusion (SHF) for offline extraction, Dynamic Hybrid Fusion (DHF) for end-to-end co-adaptation, and Temperature-Scaled Hybrid Fusion (TSHF). Inspired by multimodal learning, TSHF uses a learnable scalar to balance branch gradient dynamics and address optimization bottlenecks. translated_title: 论量子特征与经典特征的互补性：面向乳腺癌分类的自适应混合量子-经典特征融合
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习与经典深度学习的融合通过将数据映射到高维希尔伯特空间，为医学图像分析提供了有前景的途径。然而，由于优化上的不对称性，统一这两种范式仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于双分支特征提取流水线的混合量子-经典架构，用于乳腺癌诊断。我们的框架统一了来自经典模型以及可训练或确定性（不可训练）量子电路的互补表示。我们引入了三种融合策略：用于离线提取的静态混合融合（SHF）、用于端到端协同适应的动态混合融合（DHF），以及温度缩放混合融合（TSHF）。受多模态学习启发，TSHF使用一个可学习的标量来平衡分支间的梯度动态并解决优化瓶颈。我们在涵盖超声和乳腺X光影像的BreastMNIST、INbreast和BUS-UCLM数据集上进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出一种用于乳腺癌分类的自适应混合量子-经典特征融合框架，通过静态、动态和温度缩放三种融合策略统一经典模型与量子电路的互补特征表示，并利用可学习标量平衡梯度动态以解决量子与经典范式的优化不对称问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive hybrid quantum-classical feature fusion framework for breast cancer classification, which unifies complementary representations from classical models and quantum circuits through three fusion strategies (SHF, DHF, and TSHF), where the temperature-scaled fusion employs a learnable scalar to balance branch gradient dynamics and address optimization asymmetries between quantum and classical paradigms.
